goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new Site Host account, navigate to the main dashboard, and access the settings menu to reveal additional configuration options.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the main dashboard, click the settings icon (gear symbol) located in the top-right corner of the search bar to open the settings menu.
Click the vertical ellipsis button (three dots) located in the top-right corner of the search bar to reveal additional options.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the registration page to the main dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The settings menu dropdown appears below the search bar, displaying options such as 'Shown time' and 'Order'.
The vertical ellipsis button is visible and clickable within the search bar area.
The main content area displays a list of memos or reminders without any error messages.
